pages.text: Drive the rear shaft with at least 64 RPM. Five independent tanks fill at once. Use a bucket on an output face to collect that gas; sneak-use a face for quick port reassignment.

Use the machine normally to open its GUI. It shows every tank, live production rates, RPM, operating status, and each gas's output face. Click a face button to move that gas to the next port; the displaced gas swaps into its old port. Goggles and probe HUDs show a compact live summary.

Place an Isotope Separation Module in the upper GUI slot (or use the item directly on the machine). It increases stress and slowly produces Helium-3 Crystals in the lower output slot, with progress shown in the GUI and hover HUD.
